title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: We answered common questions before you start with CrewLedger and gathered the essentials in one place. Take a look!

items.question: Which apps does CrewLedger include?
items.answer: The personnel app is for workers on site; the manager app is for site and HR teams. Both run on web and mobile and use the same records.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use CrewLedger?
items.answer: No. Daily workflows use simple interfaces. Attendance, advances, and payroll steps are guided on screen — no extra setup or IT support required.

items.question: Can employees log in to the system?
items.answer: Yes. From the personnel panel they can handle attendance, approve daily wages, request advances, and view payroll with their own accounts.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: User data is encrypted with SSL and stored on secure servers. We fulfil our data-processing obligations under KVKK.

items.question: Can I manage multiple sites or projects?
items.answer: Yes. Each project is set up as a separate site; personnel, attendance, advances, and payroll are kept per project.

items.question: How can I download the app?
items.answer: On Android you can choose the personnel or manager app from Google Play. If Play Store is unavailable, install from the APK page on this site.
